title: Localized Gradient Refinement of 8-Layer Dual-Band AR Stack
scientific_hypothesis: Applying small Gaussian perturbations (±2.5%) to a high-scoring 8-layer thickness configuration while reducing optimizer step-size will reveal whether the previous optimum sits in a narrow local peak or can be further improved toward 0.999+ target score.
design_principle: Thin-film optimization landscapes often contain narrow spectral resonances where small thickness changes produce large reflectance variations. Gradient-based refinement with reduced step-size can resolve these features without overshooting, while population perturbation tests local robustness.
proposed_topology: 8-layer stack: ta2o5/sio2/ta2o5/sio2/ta2o5/sio2/ta2o5/sio2 on silicon substrate, air incidence
design_variables: individual layer thicknesses (8 variables), each perturbed by ±2.5% Gaussian from iteration_13 best candidate, bounded 20-400 nm
soft_objectives: minimize mean reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band
minimize mean reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: individual layer thickness between 20 nm and 400 nm
materials restricted to ta2o5 and sio2
theory_basis: Recalled knowledge: Quarter-wave and non-quarter-wave multilayer stacks can achieve broadband anti-reflection through impedance matching across multiple interfaces
Recalled knowledge: Ta2O5 (high index ~2.1-2.3) and SiO2 (low index ~1.45-1.46) form a standard high-contrast dielectric pair for near-IR coatings
Recalled knowledge: Gradient-based thickness optimization can converge to local optima; small perturbations test whether the optimum is isolated or part of a broader basin
Recalled knowledge: Reducing optimizer step-size near convergence prevents oscillation around narrow spectral peaks
expected_advantages: Maintains the high target score (~0.999) from iteration_13 while testing local robustness
Reduced step-size should prevent overshooting the narrow optimum region
Gaussian perturbations reveal sensitivity of each layer to thickness variation
Single topology keeps the axis focused on thickness tuning only
known_risks: Ta2O5 name resolution: I believe 'ta2o5' will resolve in the local registry, but if it matches multiple datasets the route will be rejected. The guaranteed_names list does not include ta2o5, so this depends on registry resolution. If rejected, I would need the exact measurement name from the registry's rejection list.
Index values are recalled approximations: Ta2O5 n~2.1-2.3 at 1300-1550 nm, SiO2 n~1.45-1.46. Actual measured data from the dataset will be used by the solver, not my recalled numbers.

The 2.5% perturbation magnitude is a design choice from recalled optimization practice; if too small it won't escape local traps, if too large it loses the refinement character. This would be settled by testing multiple perturbation scales.
Step-size multiplier 0.5 is recalled heuristic; the optimal value depends on the local curvature which I cannot know without running the solver.
execution_request_english: Optimize an 8-layer planar dielectric anti-reflection coating on silicon substrate. Stack sequence: Ta2O5 (Gao)/SiO2 (Lemarchand)/Ta2O5 (Gao)/SiO2 (Lemarchand)/Ta2O5 (Gao)/SiO2 (Lemarchand)/Ta2O5 (Gao)/SiO2 (Lemarchand) (8 layers total). Incident medium: air. Substrate: semi-infinite si. Wavelength bands: 1260-1360 nm and 1530-1565 nm, sampled with 401 points across both bands. Incidence angle: 0 degrees. Polarization: unpolarized. Design variables: all 8 layer thicknesses, initialized from iteration_13 best candidate thicknesses [186.89515355427594, 54.74908283070094, 61.206258309194304, 107.5698805241882, 224.3202400032046, 120.82075986426855, 21.73374005461409, 22.08119866905926] nm, each perturbed by independent ±2.5% Gaussian noise, bounded between 20 nm and 400 nm. Optimizer: gradient_thickness with step-size multiplier 0.5. Objectives: minimize mean reflectance in 1260-1360 nm band, minimize mean reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band, maximize transmittance into silicon. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and final thicknesses_nm.
revision_reason: Continuation of control arm with localized gradient refinement: applying ±2.5% Gaussian perturbations to iteration_13 best candidate thicknesses and reducing optimizer step-size multiplier to 0.5 per feedback directives.
